lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Ford calls meeting with Stellantis officials over fate of Brampton plant ‘challenging’ but productive, The Canadian Press reports.
Trump defends Putin relationship, warns AI data centres must stay in US, Al Jazeera reports.

The man accused of sparking last year’s deadly Palisades Fire was found guilty of arson charges Friday after his first federal case earlier this year ended in a mistrial, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
